title: xd3 must wire the new pre-round ready check the 4fs extension added
body:
Tick 4fs landed the between-rounds ready check as host-side wiring on the checkpoint extension, not as automatic behaviour: the WorkerAgent host (xd3) must pass ensureReady: () => env.ensureWorkspaceReady() (and onRestore for its log) when it installs workspaceCheckpointExtension, or a container lost between rounds still boots empty and the round fails ENOENT. The residual boundary — a container lost DURING a round, under a file operation, where the run-door RPC has no loss signal — remains xd3's, which owns the container's lifetime and may also call the public ensureWorkspaceReady()/restoreLostWorkspace() ahead of a round it knows the box under.
